div.span: Where every clean feels like a fresh start
div.h1: Beautiful spaces, cared for with pride.
div.p: Welcome Home Cleaning Co. delivers reliable, detail-focused cleaning for busy households, landlords, Airbnb hosts, and anyone who wants their home feeling refreshed and welcoming.

div.aria-label: Illustration of a clean home interior

div.span: Your home is protected on every visit.
Kind to your family, pets and the planet.
Not happy? Tell us within 24 hours and we'll put it right.

div.h2: Professional cleaning tailored to your home.
div.p: Whether you need a one-off refresh or regular support, we provide dependable cleaning with a high standard of care for every room and every detail.

article.p: Thorough top-to-bottom cleaning for every surface, room, and detail.
Detailed reset for move-outs, helping landlords and tenants leave with confidence.
Essential cleaning for a fresh, polished home with attention to key living spaces.
Fast, consistent turnover cleans that keep guest spaces immaculate and inviting.
Routine home cleaning designed to make daily life easier, calmer, and more comfortable.

div.p: Prices are a starting guide. We view every property before confirming your final price, and any additional charges are added after we've seen it.

div.p: Tell us about your home and the service you need. It takes about a minute.
We come to view the property, then confirm your price, including any additional charges, and agree a day and time that suits you.
Our team arrives on time, works through our checklist and leaves everything spotless.

div.h2: Reliable results, a warm approach, and a spotless finish.

div.p: We focus on the rooms, corners, and finishes that make a home feel truly reset and refreshed.
From one-off visits to regular domestic support, we work around your schedule and priorities.
Our cleaners are dependable, respectful, and committed to delivering a stress-free experience.

div.h2: Homes we’ve helped feel better than ever.

div.p: Many of our customers book again because they love the consistency, care, and finish we provide.
Clients appreciate the reliability, quality, and friendly service they receive each visit.
We offer booking options that work around your routine, from weekday cleans to weekend resets.

article.p: “The team arrived exactly on time and left the house looking spotless. The attention to detail was amazing and the communication was so easy throughout.”

div.p: We clean homes, rentals and guest properties in Milton Keynes. Further out? Ask us — we may still be able to help.
Fill in the form and we'll get in touch. We need to come and view the property first, then we'll confirm your price, including any additional charges. No obligation, no pressure.
Prefer to talk? Call 07XXX XXXXXX or message us on WhatsApp.

form.p: This opens WhatsApp with your details filled in, ready to send.

details.summary: Do you need to see my property before giving a price?
details.p: Yes. We come and view the property first so we can quote accurately. Once we've seen it, we'll confirm your price, including any additional charges, before any work starts.

details.summary: Do I need to provide cleaning products and equipment?
details.p: No. We bring our own products and equipment. If you'd like us to use something specific, just let us know.

details.summary: Do I need to be home during the clean?
details.p: Not necessarily. Many clients are out, and we can agree a key or access arrangement beforehand.

details.summary: Are your products safe for children and pets?
details.p: We use eco-conscious products. Tell us about any pets, allergies or sensitivities and we'll adapt.

details.summary: What's included in a standard clean, and what costs extra?
details.p: A standard clean covers kitchens, bathrooms, floors, surfaces and living areas. Extras such as inside the oven, inside the fridge or interior windows can be added to a deep clean or booked separately.
Please give us at least 24 hours' notice to change or cancel a booking.

details.summary: Do you clean Airbnb and rental properties?
details.p: Yes. We offer fast, consistent turnover cleans for hosts and landlords, including end of tenancy cleans.

div.h2: Ready for a cleaner, calmer home?
div.p: Get your free quote today and enjoy a fresh start with Welcome Home Cleaning Co.
where every clean feels like a fresh start.
